desc: In Curl_ssl_session_unpack, a duplicate ALPN/TICKET/QUICTP tag in crafted input overwrites s->alpn/s->sdata/s->quic_tp without freeing the prior allocation, leaking on the untrusted-decode path
On curlx_dyn_addf failure returns FALSE without curlx_dyn_free(&fbuffer); dynbuf allocation leaked on error path
On first call chlg==NULL so krb5->context allocated but InitializeSecurityContext writes &context; memcmp compares fresh context vs zeroed krb5->context (calloc'd) - benign but relies on calloc init
read_field_headers folded branch: if curlx_dyn_add/addn fails, 'err=-1; break' jumps out leaking the 'amend' dynbuf (curlx_dyn_free(&amend) at 452 skipped)

win32_stdin_read_thread: socket_r created (832) but its sclose at 869 is guarded by '&& tdata'; once CreateThread succeeds tdata is NULL, so if connect/shutdown/SetStdHandle fail afterward socket_r leaks
cf_ssl_scache_peer_init: on strdup-failure goto out calls cf_ssl_scache_clear_peer(peer) which frees all members - correct, NO leak. Verified clean.
save_etag fwrite/fputc return unchecked while the same function checks ftruncate/fseek and returns CURL_WRITEFUNC_ERROR; inconsistent write-error handling could silently truncate etag file
Return of Curl_rand_alnum assigned to 'result' but immediately overwritten by add_client_id's rc; a RNG failure is silently ignored (client id left non-random).
imap_setup_connection: if calloc of imap succeeds but Curl_meta_set fails (OOM), imap is leaked (never registered, never freed)
Curl_cpool_conn_now_idle guards if(!data) but then dereferences data->multi->maxconnects without checking data->multi for NULL (inconsistent defensive check; relies on multi-context invariant)
glob_match_url: 'if(result) return result' inside while loop and the dyn_addn(&dyn,"",0) failure return at line 698 leak dynbuf 'dyn' (never dyn_free'd; *output unset on error)
ca_info_blob->data[ca_info_blob->len-1] read with no zero-length guard; len==0 reads data[-1] (OOB). Blob is user CURLOPT_CAINFO_BLOB.
ssl_cert_blob->data[ssl_cert_blob->len-1] read with no zero-length guard; len==0 reads data[-1] (OOB) for cert_blob.
do_pubkey ecPublicKey: (pubkey->end - pubkey->beg - 2)*4 underflows if pubkey span < 2 bytes, huge size_t logged/pushed.
varexpand: 'return PARAM_EXPAND_ERROR' on null-byte detection skips curlx_dyn_free(&buf); leaks buf when funcp populated it (line 296)

len (unsigned int) = HMAC_MD5_LENGTH + NTLMv2_BLOB_LEN where BLOB_LEN includes ntlm->target_info_len (parsed from server type-2 msg). If target_info_len near UINT_MAX, len wraps small -> calloc small -> memcpy(ptr+44,target_info,target_info_len) heap overflow. Bounded only by upstream type-2 parser; defense-in-depth missing here.

c_escape() can return NULL on OOM but escaped is passed straight to easysrc_addf("%s") without a NULL check in TOOLMIME_DATA/FILE/encoder/filename/name/type cases (lines 438,449,479,486,493,500), unlike libcurl_generate_slist which guards. NULL passed to printf %s = deref/UB.
On curlx_dyn_addn failure the function returns without curlx_dyn_free(&dirbuf), leaking the already-allocated dynbuf when failure occurs after a prior successful append
